disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Biotech carries binary clinical risk; AI-discovery names trade on platform narratives years ahead of any FDA approval.
footnote: Figures approximate, from public quote pages as of the Oct 16, 2026 close. Refreshed weekly (Mondays). Exact Sciences (EXAS) was acquired by Abbott and delisted Mar 23, 2026, so it is no longer tracked as a listed name. Always confirm current prices/valuations independently.

kpis.sub: ILLUMINA (ILMN) SLIPS TO $262 AS THE BIOINSIGHT PLATFORM LAUNCHES; TARGET CREEPS UP TO $241
kpis.label: ILMN closed at $262.54 on Oct 16 (-2.0% on the day, down from $278.17 a week earlier), roughly 49x trailing earnings. The 21-analyst average target rose to $241.05 (about 8% below price); TD Cowen lifted to $270 (Hold) while BofA sits at $168 (Underperform). Illumina launched its BioInsight multiomic software platform (~Oct 13) and set up a $1B commercial paper program. Q3 results are due Oct 29 after the close.

kpis.sub: TEMPUS AI (TEM) FALLS 9% ON OCT 16 TO $64.72; Q3 RESULTS NOW SET FOR NOV 2
kpis.label: TEM closed at $64.72 on Oct 16 (-9.0% on the day; $70.93 a week earlier), market cap $11.68B, with a $74.94 consensus target. TTM revenue is $1.43B (+50%) against a net loss near $254M. Analysts kept raising targets into the drop (JPMorgan $70, Canaccord $95, BofA $75); the Moderna/Merck collaboration (Oct 6) and Ambry's GenomeNext whole-genome test are the operating news.

kpis.sub: RECURSION (RXRX) -17% ON OCT 16 AFTER A $200M OFFERING AT $3.25; SANOFI OPTS IN TO AN IMMUNOLOGY CANDIDATE
kpis.label: RXRX closed at $3.465 on Oct 16 (-16.7%; $4.36 a week earlier), market cap $2.07B, after pricing a $200M underwritten offering at $3.25 on Oct 15. The same day Sanofi opted to take a first-in-class immunology candidate into its pipeline (Phase 1 planned 2027) with a $10M milestone; early REC-1245 data and a REC-4881 update followed (~Oct 14). Average target $7.32; Q3 earnings est. Nov 4.

kpis.sub: ARKG CLOSES $46.70 (-5.2% ON OCT 16); 1-YEAR RETURN FALLS TO ~44.7% FROM ~59.7%
kpis.label: ARKG closed at $46.70 on Oct 16 (-5.16%) with 35 holdings, a 0.75% expense ratio, a trailing 1-year return of about 44.7% (about 59.7% a week earlier) and about 7.95% a year since its Oct 31, 2014 inception. Top-10 weight is 58.43% (10x Genomics 8.74%, Tempus 8.62%, Twist 8.22%). AUM is about $2.0B by shares outstanding (43.05M x $46.70); one quote page showed $4.06B, which does not reconcile and is not used.

The leveraged, small-cap and genomics names took the damage: RXRX -17%, SDGR -11%, QSI -15%, TEM -9%, GENB -7%. Illumina unveiled BioInsight, a unified genomic and multiomic analysis environment (~Oct 13), after SpliceAI2 earlier in the month. TD Cowen raised its target to $270 from $210 (Hold); BofA raised to $168 from $140 (Underperform). Results land Oct 29 after the close.

themes.tag: AI-NATIVE PLATFORMS: PARTNERSHIP WINS, DILUTION FOLLOWS
themes.title: Recursion raises $200M at $3.25 as Sanofi opts in; Generate signs Zealand Pharma; Eikon files an IND
themes.description: RXRX's Sanofi opt-in and $10M milestone (Oct 15) was immediately paired with a $200M offering, a reminder that platform partnerships fund operations rather than prove drugs. Generate Biomedicines signed an AI-engineered metabolic-protein deal with Zealand Pharma (Oct 13) yet trades at $12.09, 24% below its $16 IPO price. Eikon submitted an IND for EIK1006, an androgen-receptor antagonist (Oct 15). Schrödinger's Bunsen AI co-scientist remains the software-revenue story; SDGR fell 11% to $22.60.

themes.tag: DIAGNOSTICS: SHIELD DATA AND A PATENT LOSS
themes.title: Guardant publishes Shield screening-adherence data but the PTAB again rejects its TwinStrand patent challenge
themes.description: GH closed $158.60 (-4.4%; $167.47 a week earlier) against a $201.64 consensus target. The Shield blood-test data (Oct 15) is positive; the PTAB's second rejection of Guardant's challenge to a core TwinStrand patent (~Oct 14) keeps the litigation overhang alive. Q3 results Nov 5. Exact Sciences is no longer a public comparison: Abbott closed its ~$21B acquisition at $105/share in March.

themes.tag: ARKG: BUYING THE DIP IN PLATFORM NAMES
themes.title: ARK reportedly bought 4.2M RXRX shares on Oct 15 after 1.9M on Oct 7 and 1.5M on Oct 5; also adding Intellia
themes.description: Reported ARK trades (via aggregator pages, not ARK's own file) show repeated Recursion buying into the offering week and several Intellia purchases in late Sept/early Oct. ARKG's trailing-year return has fallen to about 44.7% from about 87% two weeks ago, and the since-inception rate has slipped to about 7.95% a year. The 12-year record is the honest context for any single strong year.

private_watchlist.name: Isomorphic Labs
private_watchlist.note: Bloomberg reported preliminary talks to raise at a valuation of at least $40B (possibly up to $50B), versus about $17.5B previously; no deal is final and the amount was not disclosed. It closed a $2.1B Series B in May 2026 and still targets first trials by year-end 2026 for ISM8969. Alphabet ownership makes a near-term IPO unlikely.

private_watchlist.name: Insilico Medicine
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Rentosertib's Phase III (GENESIS-IPF) remains underway with a realistic approval window of 2029-2030 per the lead investigator's own estimate — years, not quarters, from here. Still the only name in this group already public (HKEX, Dec 2025, $292M IPO).

private_watchlist.name: Xaira Therapeutics
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. The company continues hiring out its business-development function to line up partnerships that supply preclinical disease-area data rather than capital — it says the $1.3B already raised covers its near-term needs — but no partner has been named and no trial has started.

private_watchlist.name: NewLimit
private_watchlist.note: No fresh update found this week. Still the year's largest single disclosed longevity round (~71% of 2026's disclosed longevity funding through August); its first candidate medicine remains in large-scale manufacturing with clinical entry targeted as early as 2027.

bear_case.title: Biology still fails in the clinic — and the clock hasn't moved
bear_case.description: Zero AI-discovered drugs have reached full FDA approval out of 200+ in clinical development. Insilico's lead investigator puts rentosertib's realistic approval at 2029-2030. Intellia's BLA (PDUFA Mar 10, 2027) is gene editing, not AI discovery; Barclays initiated Underweight ($8) on commercial headwinds.

bear_case.title: Platform partnerships are financed by dilution
bear_case.description: Recursion raised $200M at $3.25 (Oct 15) the same day Sanofi opted in to a candidate; the stock fell 17% on Oct 16. Relay raised $275M at $12 in May. Generate ($12.09 vs $16 IPO) and Eikon ($7.42 vs $18) show how IPO-window names fade without an approved drug.

bear_case.title: Illumina and Tempus price ahead of fundamentals
bear_case.description: ILMN ($262.54) is about 8% above its $241.05 average target at ~49x earnings, with BofA at $168; Q3 prints Oct 29. TEM ($64.72) is still loss-making (net loss ~$254M TTM) and fell 9% in a day; Q3 is Nov 2.

bear_case.title: Diagnostics litigation and sub-scale proteomics
bear_case.description: Guardant's PTAB challenge to a core TwinStrand patent was rejected again (~Oct 14) and the federal judgment appeal is open. Quantum-Si ($1.12, -14.5% on Oct 16) has TTM revenue of $1.61M (-53%), a $245M market cap and a launch not until Q2 2027.

bear_case.title: A one-day -3.7% XBI move shows the rate and funding-cycle fragility
bear_case.description: XBI closed $144.32 on Oct 16 (52-week range $106.30-$169.89; 1-year gain ~33.8%, down from ~46% a week earlier). ARKG fell 5.2% the same day. Rallies this extended reverse on a hawkish rates move or failed readout; the PhRMA lawsuit against the administration (Oct 7) adds policy noise.
